# nb-studio attachment

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## attachment delete

Delete a file

An issue’s own file, by its uploader or by whoever may moderate comments on the issue; a comment’s files go with the comment.

```bash
nb-studio attachment delete <file>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `file`   |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                 |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete this file?” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.attachments/upload`.

**Request:** `DELETE /api/projects/attachments/{attachmentId}` (`projectsDeleteAttachment`)

## attachment get

Get a file

Readable by whoever sees its issue; an upload attached to nothing by its uploader only.

```bash
nb-studio attachment get <file>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `file`   |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/projects/attachments/{attachmentId}` (`projectsGetAttachment`)

## attachment upload

Upload a file

Needs `upload` on `pm.attachments`. One file as the `file` field of a multipart body, at most 20971520 bytes. The upload is attached to nothing until it is sent with a comment (`attachmentIds`); one left so for 24 hours is purged.

```bash
nb-studio attachment upload --file <path>
```

| Flag     | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `--file` | path | (required)  |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.attachments/upload`.

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/attachments` (`projectsUploadAttachment`)
